description:
Publish (to the people you message) when your user's assistant reads messages. It does not check
        anything: actual checks need a scheduled task in your app, and most apps allow hourly at the shortest.
        every_minutes: the real interval of that task, e.g. 60 (5 to 10080).
        next_check_at: a one-off time, ISO 8601 UTC (e.g. when your user says "I'll look again at 6pm"); within 7
        days. clear=true removes the schedule. While your user is connected they show as online automatically.
name: publish_check_schedule
